ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-intensity pixels (approx. 85% coverage) with localized high-intensity white mottling (approx. 15% coverage) concentrated on the left lobe and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white pixel clusters are mapped along the trailing edge of the left lobe and both lobe tips. The central, medial, and leading-edge regions of both lobes consist of solid low-intensity black pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated trailing edge exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (2-5 pixel amplitude) along the lobes, transitioning to highly irregular, textured topography at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a symmetrical upward convexity along the leading edge and a pronounced concavity along the trailing edge leading to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered high-intensity circular pixel clusters (1-4 pixels diameter) localized on the left lobe ventral surface and concentrated within the white pigmentation of the tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization (barnacles) appearing as high-contrast, textured brown and white pixel clusters at the extreme distal ends of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The 2D silhouette of the lobe tips is heavily modified by dense, irregular acorn barnacle encrustation.
